title: 48 Hours in New York Without Touching Times Square
description: New York gets reduced to a checklist, which is exactly wrong. Two days covering a proper bagel in Brooklyn, the High Line before the crowds wake up, dollar-ish slices that still exist if you know where, and a sunset from Top of the Rock's cheaper cousin in Long Island City. No Times Square, no regrets, and less money spent than you'd think.

comments.comment: Which bagel place? This matters more than anything else in the itinerary and you know it.
Shelsky's if you want to sit down, Bagel Hole if you want to be humbled by a queue of locals at 8am.
Lived there three years and never once went to Times Square on purpose. This itinerary is the correct one.
